english.title: Supply weighing / measuring equipment after its certificate of approval had expired / been revoked
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a certificate of approval in respect of a pattern of

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), had

(C)_[expired,]_
(D)_[been revoked in a case falling within section 12(1)(b) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985,]_

supplied to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), equipment of the pattern in question which was marked with a stamp and which was not used for trade at a time when the certificate was in force otherwise than by virtue of section 12(11) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(2) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes:
(i) Section 13(2) of the of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that In England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
